title: Analysis: Kevin Warsh sharpens inflation warning at Jackson Hole, signaling possible rate hike
summary_full: After confusing markets at his July news conference, Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh used Jackson Hole to give a clearer view of the case for higher interest rates.
